source_compatibility: Fractional random_split is converted to the PyTorch1.13+ allocation before the unchanged Torch1.12 integer splitter; original generator42 retained. Only empty Torchdyn auxiliary args are adapted on the original FlowSolver drift and VelocityNet forward methods; same values/gradients/ODE formula, nonempty args rejected. SB calc_mu_sigma runs its original Gaussian formula through a read-only normalized-pair view to repair its non-trajectory assertion; original coupling, leaveout bridging, target and time rescaling remain. This is a disclosed source repair, not historical execution proof.
boundary: All120 full available-data/source-method/recipe/leftout/seed conditions; original1000-epoch maxima and both complete stopping recipes. Original author constructors, losses, optimizer, solver and all full test timepoint arrays execute unchanged. Paper RK45(rk4) wording is ambiguous; literal rk4 is a disclosed separate recipe. Released donor32606 is not paper donor13176; independent donor13176 input is not a certified historical artifact. Validation loss includes leftout-timepoint validation observations and whitening fits all selected timepoints, as release code does. Five training seeds remain separate from two heldout times. EB/CITE/DSB/TrajectoryNet/other original branches and full45-paper scope remain required. Additional explicitly named original-author CUDA FP32 execution;all CPU cases and locks remain unchanged. No additional independent seeds,CPU completion credit or historical equivalence. Full24 actual batches/ODE/source paths and complete CPU/GPU initial velocity fields must pass before any full training. Every source fit must pass its actual guard and complete fresh native test/W1 LP audit before completion credit.
